test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required if the sentence is correct as given.

(The shocked entrance) of so many witnesses seemed to have brought them to their senses.
solution:
The correct answer is "**The unexpected entrance.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "shocked" implies surprise or disbelief.
 
• **Among the given options, "unexpected" is a more appropriate replacement than "shocking" or "unexpecting."**
 
• Unexpecting refers to the state of being unprepared or caught off guard.
 
• **While unexpected refers to something that was not foreseen or anticipated which fits the context of the sentence.**(अनपेक्षित)
 
 
• Example: There will be unexpected effects of your decision.
 
 
 
• "Entrances" should be singular, as it refers to the overall entrance of the witnesses rather than multiple individual entrances.
 
• Thus, the given phrase will be replaced by the phrase "the unexpected entrance."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "The shocking entrances," is incorrect because "shocking" implies a negative connotation and does not accurately convey the surprise of the witnesses' entrance.
 
• Option 3, "The unexpecting entrances," is incorrect because "unexpecting" is not a proper adjective and does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
